tools.name: get_platform_specs
tools.description: Use this when an author asks what Amazon KDP, IngramSpark or Lulu require for a print book: available trim sizes, interior bleed, margin and gutter minimums, page-count limits by binding and paper, spine-text minimum, and file rules (embedded fonts, 300 DPI images, file size, color, no encryption).

tools.name: calculate_spine_width
tools.description: Use this when an author asks for a book's spine width for KDP, IngramSpark or Lulu, or whether their book is thick enough for spine text. Takes the interior page count, binding and paper; returns the width in inches and mm, the formula used, the spine-text rule and a link to check it on pdfdocprefli

tools.name: calculate_cover_size
tools.description: Use this when an author asks how big their full wraparound paperback or hardcover cover file must be for KDP, IngramSpark or Lulu.
